run_pybullet_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads a robot URDF and steps the physics loop
load_urdf_robot: load a robot URDF file into a pybullet simulation with a specified start position and orientation
connect_pybullet_gui: connect to a pybullet GUI client and configure gravity and search paths for URDF assets
step_simulation_loop: step a pybullet simulation loop at a fixed timestep while printing robot base pose
get_robot_pose: get the base position and orientation of a loaded robot in a pybullet simulation
